_about: Copy this file into TMR's folder (beside tmr.exe, or TMR_HOME) as window.json and edit it.
It is read when the window opens. Keys starting with _ are notes.
chart: the throughput chart shows. theme: system, light or dark.
start_on_open: the run starts as the window opens, as --start does.
parameters: the parameters box's text when tmr.exe is given none; the window keeps the last run's.
size: [width, height], as it last closed.
colours: #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB (alpha first). Leave a key out to keep its default.

colours._note: egui's grey text instead of WinUI's white: dark.text_primary #8C8C8C, light.text_primary #505050.

_keys.text_primary: most text: title, table cells, error lines, card titles, CPU name
_keys.text_secondary: info line, table headings, empty-state lines, chart axis labels, the chart's stage lines and labels
_keys.error: error bullets, a non-zero error count, the chart's error marks
_keys.critical: the 'Failed' badge fill, the Stop button
_keys.on_status: badge text, the Stop button's text
_keys.chart_seal: the chart's line where the figures are the seal's work
_keys.chart_grid: the chart's gridlines, the header divider
_keys.progress_text: the percentage inside the progress bar
